notes.variants: the 16 masters __pv0..15 differ only in QID/G parameters but synthesise to 3 classes (r18h5 views/synth std_area_um2: pv0 Q0G0 583.2k, pv1-7 heavy G0/1 534.6k, pv8-15 light G2/3 287.7k; each + 192 SRAM 128x256 = 0.75 mm2). With STRAP=1 (pos pin = {qid,g}) one physical kit per class; ft ports make every INSTANCE its own variant (slot y offsets of 150 um between g0/g1 columns, per-instance lane loads), as the 16 SYNTH pv cells already are.
notes.ft_set: recommended = gain (lanes whose straight route saves >= 1 stage at 1.0 mm hops); all-lanes overloads 8 faces (>0.6). pilot = gain lanes on the stream die clock (one ft root ck_ft 833.333 ps); serial (6%) / unresolved (4%) lanes stay in the channels until a second ft clock is added.
notes.ports: E-W ft on M8 (W/E faces), N-S ft on M9 (N/S faces); ranges = FT-TOOL plan_v2 per-face legalised, die-frame tracks: 929 of 935 neighbour ft legs line up at 0.0 um in die coordinates (the 2.2-mm column gaps / 459-um row gaps between SU slots carry the die-level hop, 1 relay at most at 1.0-1.2 mm reach).
notes.registers: in + out registered at the pins (pin-register rule), one more every <= 1.0 mm (E-W 1797 um: 3 regs / latency 3 cycles incl. the pin regs; N-S 2825 um: 4 regs), repeater sites <= 450 um (rep_sites per path; block P&R inserts them). latency_cycles per path = regs (each register is one die-relay stage moved inside the block: static schedule takes FT-TOOL hbm_schedule.tsv stages_new).
notes.stations: ot_hbm_rly #(W, RS_RELAY 1) = the hbfd_rly die relay function (posedge, async clear, 3-edge reset release), reset rs_ft through a 2-level ot_rst_relay (<= 32 loads a net).
notes.kit: physical/ref_tile/hbm_su_pgslice_lg_ft_d4g: light landed-region slice (rgf_lp, 32 KIND0 + 32 CLOSED bank6_clock) re-laid in the die slot 1797.12 x 2825.28 (the light kit 1235.52 x 3045.6 did not fit); children 2.52 mm2 = 49.6% of the slot, parent fill ~52-55% with glue + ft (below the 60-70% target because the hard children are themselves ~45% dense; a narrower outline cannot hold 3 pair columns, 2 columns need 16 rows > 2825 um). PG top M7 (pins), signals M2-M7, ft nets M8/M9 inside corridors only (pushdown FASTROUTE fence + ft_audit), abstract = exact routed shapes (ref_tile export).
notes.not_covered: heavy G0/1 and Q0G0 classes need hardened KIND1/KIND2 leaves (none CLOSED); the light rgf_lp interface/latency differs from the r18h5 die binding (monolithic scoped_d4g pgslice.sv SYNTH): binding needs the lp record offsets in the SU schedule + the sibling stream tile (HBM-PGLG8 / codex pgstream-safe3-bind).
